description.value: Since 1988, Caffe Barney has been a neighbourhood institution on South Granville, serving brunch, lunch, dinner, and late-night comfort food in a warm, artsy interior with a street-facing patio. The kitchen prepares everything in-house and the bar pours a rotating selection of twelve local craft beers on tap alongside cocktails and wine. Situated minutes from Kits Beach and downtown Vancouver, it is a well-positioned refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the South Granville corridor.
